headline: Working together
intro: I'm drawn to unposed, candid moments, and to the places, events and buildings where they happen. I like frames that feel found rather than staged. I'm open to paid work in the Omaha area, including events, community coverage, conferences and architecture. If you have a project in mind, send me the details and I'll let you know if I can help.

services.name: Unposed & candid moments
services.description: Real moments as they unfold, captured without staging or interruption.

services.name: Places & events
services.description: Documentary-style coverage of local events, conferences and gatherings, plus landscapes and destinations.

services.name: Buildings & architecture
services.description: Exteriors, interiors and details. Clean lines, true verticals and natural light.

services.name: Licensing & custom work
services.description: Existing images for editorial, web or print, or something made for your project.

contactText: Have a project, event or licensing question? Send me the date, location and what you need, and I'll get back to you with my availability.
